priorReport.claim1: only three semantic /health files remain modified

conflictAsPresented.instructionCompliance: Neither report was assumed correct. Both were tested independently against repository evidence.

finding1_priorReportIsCORRECT.method: Independent re-derivation of the ee664eab..ff1bc2b1 delta without consulting the sealed CP73 manifest, followed by cross-check against it.
commands: git diff --name-status ee664eab ff1bc2b1  -> 266 A, 598 M

crossCheckAgainstSealedManifest.note: 259 ADDED_EVIDENCE + 7 ADDED_UNEXPLAINED = 266 ADDED, matching the independent count.

the266to265Explanation.reasonExcluded: Suppressed from untracked enumeration by the user-global excludes file C:\Users\USER/.config/git/ignore containing the single pattern '**/.claude/settings.local.json'. The file EXISTS on disk; it is ignored, not missing.
the266to265Explanation.verification: git check-ignore -v .claude/settings.local.json resolves to the global ignore rule.
the266to265Explanation.conclusion: The prior report's '265 of 266' is EXACTLY CORRECT and fully explained.

workingTreeBytePreservationVerified.method: git diff --stat ff1bc2b1 -- <3 semantic paths> and per-file SHA-256 of the working-tree copies
workingTreeBytePreservationVerified.result: The three semantic /health files in the working tree are byte-identical to their content in the preserved ungoverned commit ff1bc2b1. No ungoverned byte was lost by the R3-alpha mixed reset.

decisiveExperiment.description: A Git index was materialised from HEAD with NO stat cache, into a temporary index file outside the repository. The real .git/index was never touched. git diff-files was then evaluated against that fresh index.
commands: GIT_INDEX_FILE=<scratchpad>/testidx git diff-files --name-status | cut -f1 | sort | uniq -c   -> 13973 M, 2 D

theTwoDeletedEntries.skipWorktreeFlag: S (skip-worktree) on both, per git ls-files -v
theTwoDeletedEntries.rootCause: 'CON' is a reserved Windows device name and cannot be materialised as a directory on this filesystem. Both paths are therefore held under sparse-checkout skip-worktree bits and are intentionally absent from the working tree.
theTwoDeletedEntries.behaviourUnderRealIndex: Correctly suppressed — git status reports neither modification nor deletion.
theTwoDeletedEntries.behaviourUnderFreshIndex: skip-worktree bits are NOT reproduced by read-tree, so both paths surface as deletions.
theTwoDeletedEntries.significance: This is precisely why the artifact count is 13,973 and not 13,975.

finding2_laterSnapshotIsAN_ARTIFACT.mechanism: Immediately after an index-rewriting operation (such as the authorised R3-alpha 'git reset --mixed'), index entries carry no valid stat data. Until a refresh repopulates the stat cache, git must treat every tracked entry as potentially changed, and a status/diff taken in that window reports the entire tracked tree as modified. The reported 13,973 is the exact signature of that window on this repository.

hypothesesTestedAndREFUTED.hypothesis: core.autocrlf line-ending renormalisation across the tree
hypothesesTestedAndREFUTED.verdict: REFUTED as the sole cause; EOL settings alone do not produce the number.

hypothesesTestedAndREFUTED.test: Direct status against the live index, re-measured at operation start and end

finding2_laterSnapshotIsAN_ARTIFACT.conclusion: The 13,973 figure is an index-state measurement artifact. It does NOT represent divergent file content, does NOT indicate loss, and does NOT contradict the prior report. Both reports describe the same repository at different index-refresh states.

finding3_the282UntrackedFigure.explanation: 281 enumerated untracked paths + .claude/settings.local.json (present, added by ff1bc2b1, suppressed by the user-global excludes file) = 282. An enumeration performed without that global excludes file in effect — for example by a process running under a different HOME or a non-standard excludes configuration — yields exactly 282.
finding3_the282UntrackedFigure.residualUncertainty: The exact enumeration environment of the 282 snapshot was not recoverable from repository evidence. The one-path delta is nevertheless fully identified by name and status, is benign, and involves no governed or evidence content.

attemptedTestThatWasINVALID.assessment: INVALID ON THIS PLATFORM. The /dev/null path collapsed untracked enumeration entirely under Git-for-Windows; the result is discarded and is NOT used as evidence.

overallVerdict.reportsAreNotInConflict: Both are correct observations of the same unchanged repository taken at different index-refresh states. The apparent conflict dissolves once the stat-cache mechanism and the two skip-worktree paths are accounted for.
